The evaluator is in `src/calc.nim`, and `build.sh` compiles it as a release build to `./app`. `node check.mjs` passes all 6 example cases.

I also ran some edge cases by hand and they behaved as the spec says. Results at the 64-bit limits are right, including `(-9223372036854775807 - 1) % -1` giving `0`. Bad syntax and overflow print `error`. It parses without recursion, so very deep nesting doesn't crash it: 200,000 nested parentheses worked. A million lines ran in about 0.3 seconds.
